Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:10:1.hebrew: ותסברא - דהאי שינויא דלעיל שינויא הוא, וטעמא דרישא משום דבידו הוא? נהי דבידו — לקבל קידושין מאיש שבא לקדשה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:10:1.english: And do you understand [it that way]? - [Do you really think] that this resolution above is a [valid] resolution, and the reason for the first clause is because it is in his power? [Regarding the words,] “Granted that it is in his power” — [this means] to accept betrothal from a man who comes to betroth her.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:10:2.hebrew: אילו אמר האי גברא לא ניחא לי - לקדשה, מי מצי וכו':
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:10:2.english: If this man said, “It is not pleasing to me” - To betroth her, can [the father] etc.:

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:11:1.hebrew: לאיש אסרה - על הכל, שאין אנו יודעים למי; וכי אמר ״הזה״ — התירה לזה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:11:1.english: “To a man,” he rendered her forbidden - To everyone, as we do not know to whom; and when he said “this [one],” he permitted her to this [one].

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:12:1.hebrew: לנישואין הימניה - אם נערה, אם קטנה. אבל בבוגרת לא מישתעי קרא, דנערה כתיב; הלכך, לא מהימן משגדלה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:12:1.english: With regard to marriage, He deemed him credible - Whether [she is] a young woman [na'arah] or whether a minor [ketanah]. But regarding a grown woman [bogeret], Scripture does not speak, for “na'arah” is written; therefore, he is not deemed credible once she has grown up.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:12:2.english: With regard to a captive - They did not deem him credible at all.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:13:1.english: I have children - And [so] his wife is not bound to a yavam.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:13:2.hebrew: יש לי אחים - זקוקה ליבם, והיא היתה עד הנה בחזקת שאינה זקוקה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:13:2.english: I have brothers - [Meaning that she is] bound to a levir, whereas until now she was under the presumption of not being bound [to a levir].

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:14:1.hebrew: בשעת קידושין אמר יש לי בנים - כדי שלא תדאג מן הייבום ותתרצה לו. ומיהו, כשקידשה לא אמר על מנת:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:14:1.english: At the time of betrothal he said, “I have children” - [He said this] so that she would not worry about levirate marriage and would consent to him. However, when he betrothed her, he did not say [it was] on condition.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:15:1.hebrew: בשעת קידושין אמר יש לי בנים - כדי שלא תדאג מן הייבום ותתרצה לו. ומיהו, כשקידשה לא אמר "על מנת":
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:15:1.english: At the time of betrothal he said: "I have children" - [He said this] so that she would not worry about levirate marriage and would consent to [marry] him. However, when he betrothed her, he did not say, "On condition [that...]."

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:15:2.english: At the time of betrothal he said that he has no brothers - And there is no need to worry about levirate marriage.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:15:3.hebrew: נאמן להתיר כו' - כלומר, נאמן במה שאמר בשעת קידושין, ואין נאמן במה שאמר בשעת מיתה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:15:3.english: He is deemed credible to render [her] permitted, etc. - That is to say, he is deemed credible in what he said at the time of betrothal, and is not deemed credible in what he said at the time of death.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:16:1.hebrew: שאני התם - בברייתא, כיון דהדר ביה מדיבורא קמא בשעת מיתה — קושטא קאמר, שלא יהא עון תלוי בו. אבל מתני', שלא אמר בשעת קידושין "אין לי אחים", כי אמר השתא "יש לי" — אינו נאמן, דלצעורה קא מכוין:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:16:1.english: There it is different - In the baraita: since he retracted his first statement at the time of death, he is speaking the truth, so that sin should not hang upon him. But [in] the mishna, where he did not say at the time of betrothal, “I have no brothers,” when he says now, “I have [brothers],” he is not believed, for he intends to cause her distress.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:16:2.english: Where he weakens his statement - [That he made] at the time of betrothal.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:17:1.hebrew: דלא מוחזק לן - האי גברא בשעת מיתה, לא באחי ולא בבני, וקיימא הך איתתא בחזקת שאינה זקוקה לייבום. הלכך, אמר ״יש לי בנים״ — אחזקה קמייתא הוא דקא מוקים לה, הלכך נאמן. ואי אתי אח לאחר מכאן ואמר ״אחוה דמיתנא אנא״ — לאו כל כמיניה, דאהני דיבור לחזקה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:17:1.english: Where we do not have a presumptive status - [With regard to] this man at the time of death, [we have no presumption,] neither with regard to brothers nor with regard to children, and this woman stands in the presumptive status that she is not subject to levirate marriage. Therefore, [if] he said, “I have children,” he is establishing her upon [her] initial presumption; therefore, he is deemed credible. And if a brother comes afterward and says, “I am the brother of the deceased,” it is not in his power [to render her forbidden], for [the husband’s] statement was effective [combined] with the presumption.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:17:2.hebrew: אמר יש לי אחים - ואין לי בנים, לאו כל כמיניה דמפקינן לה מחזקה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:17:2.english: [If] he said: "I have brothers" - And "I have no children" — it is not within his power that we should remove her from her presumption.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:17:3.hebrew: ברייתא - דקא"ר נתן נאמן לאסור:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:17:3.english: The baraita - Where Rabbi Natan says [that he is] deemed credible to render [her] forbidden.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:1:1.hebrew: ולחרמים - אם החרימו מנכסיהם, הוי חרם לבדק הבית, וקדשים; וכן אם אמר ״ערכי עלי״ — נערך:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:1:1.english: And with regard to dedications - If they dedicated [any] of their property, it is a dedication to Temple maintenance; and [with regard to] consecrations, [they become] consecrated; and likewise, if one said: “My valuation is upon me,” he is evaluated.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:1:2.english: But not for lashes - To establish their hairs under the presumption of [being a valid] sign [of majority], [for them] to receive lashes and to be punished.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:2:1.english: I divorced her - I accepted her bill of divorce.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:2:2.english: And she is a minor - Now, when he said this about her.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:2:3.english: [He is] deemed credible - To disqualify her from the priesthood.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:2:4.hebrew: והרי היא גדולה - משגדלה אמר כן, ובקטנותה לא אמר — אינו נאמן, ומותרת לכהן:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:2:4.english: And she is an adult woman - [If] he said this after she became an adult, and he did not say [it] during her minority — he is not believed, and she is permitted to [marry] a priest.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:2:5.hebrew: נשבית - הרי היא פסולה לכהונה משום ספק זונה, ובגמרא מפרש טעמא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:2:5.english: She was taken captive - Behold, she is disqualified from the priesthood on account of doubt of [her being a] zonah, and in the Gemara, [it] explains the reason.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:3:1.hebrew: רישא בידו - בעודנה קטנה, בידו לקדשה לאחר ולחזור ולקבל גט הימנו. הלכך נאמן, דמה לו לשקר — אי בעי, פסיל לה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:3:1.english: In the first clause, [it is] in his power - While she is still a minor, it is in his power to betroth her to another and then receive a bill of divorce from him. Therefore, he is believed, for why would he lie — if he wanted, he could disqualify her.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:3:2.hebrew: סיפא לאו בידו - לקדשה משגדלה, ולא למוסרה ביד עובד כוכבים — לא גדולה ולא קטנה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:3:2.english: The latter clause [is] not in his power - To betroth her once she has grown up, nor to deliver her into the hand of an idolater — neither [when she is] an adult nor [when she is] a minor.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:4:1.english: And behold, it is in his power - When she is a minor.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:4:2.hebrew: להשיאה לחלל - לנולד מאלמנה לכ"ג, דאמר לקמן בפרק בתרא (קידושין דף עד:): עמוני ומואבי, כותי, נתין, חלל וממזר, מצרי ואדומי, שבאו על כהנת, לוייה וישראלית — פסלוה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:4:2.english: To marry her off to a ḥalal - To [one] born of a widow to a High Priest; as it says later, in the final chapter (Kiddushin 74b): An Ammonite and a Moabite, a Samaritan, a Gibeonite [Netin], a ḥalal, and a mamzer, an Egyptian, and an Edomite who had relations with a woman of priestly, Levite, or Israelite lineage — they have disqualified her.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:5:1.hebrew: כר' דוסתאי בן יהודה - ס"ל לתנא דידן, דאמר לקמן (קידושין דף עז.): בנות ישראל מקוה טהרה לחללים, דבת חלל זכר כשרה לכהונה, שאשתו טהרה את זרעו. וכיון דבתו כשרה — אלמנתו כשרה, דכל שאתה נושא בתו אתה נושא אלמנתו. הלכך, אין בידו לפסול בתו קטנה מן הכהונה. וא"ת: הרי בידו לפסלה בקידושין וגירושין? התם, מכהונה פסיל לה, מתרומה לא פסיל לה אם בת כהן היא; אבל נשבית — פסולה אף מן התרומה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:5:1.english: In accordance with Rabbi Dostai ben Yehuda - Our Tanna holds in accordance with [Rabbi Dostai ben Yehuda], who says below (Kiddushin 77a): "The daughters of Israelites are a ritual bath of purification for individuals of ḥalal status" — that the daughter of a male ḥalal is qualified [to marry into] the priesthood, as his [Israelite] wife purified his offspring. And since his daughter is qualified, his widow is qualified [to marry a priest], for [the principle is]: Whenever you may marry his daughter, you may marry his widow. Therefore, it is not in his power to disqualify his minor daughter from the priesthood [by marrying her to a ḥalal]. And if you say: But behold, it is in his power to disqualify her [from the priesthood] through betrothal and divorce? There, he [only] disqualifies her from [marrying into] the priesthood, [but] he does not disqualify her from [eating] terumah if she is the daughter of a priest; but [if] she was taken captive, she is disqualified even from terumah.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:5:2.hebrew: שהרי אמרה תורה אלמנה לא יקח - וסמיך ליה ולא יחלל זרעו בעמיו, דמשמע חללין הוא עושה זרעו, שמחוללין מן הכהונה, ואינו עושה ממזרין. וכיון דאין הולד ממזר, ש"מ ס"ל קידושין תופסין בחייבי לאוין דכהונה. דאי אין קידושין תופסין, הוי הולד ממזר, כדתנן בפרקין (לעיל קידושין סו:) כל שאין לה קידושין עליו הולד ממזר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:5:2.english: For the Torah said, "A widow he shall not take" - and right next to it [it says], "and he shall not profane his seed among his people." This implies that he makes his offspring ḥalalim, who are profaned from the priesthood, and he does not make [them] mamzerim. And since the offspring is not a mamzer, we learn that [the Tanna] holds that betrothal takes effect with those forbidden by a prohibition [applying] to the priesthood. For if betrothal did not take effect, the offspring would be a mamzer, as we learned in our chapter (above, Kiddushin 66b): "Any woman who has no betrothal with him, the offspring is a mamzer."

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:6:1.hebrew: והרי בידו להשיאה לממזר - דקיימא לן (לקמן קידושין דף סח.) קידושין תופסין בחייבי לאוין, וביד האב להשיאה לו בעבירה, ותפסל מן התרומה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:6:1.english: But it is in his power to marry her to a mamzer - For we maintain (below, Kiddushin 68a) that betrothal takes effect with those subject to negative prohibitions, and it is in the father’s power to marry her to him in transgression, and she will be disqualified from [eating] terumah.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:6:2.hebrew: אין קידושין תופסין בחייבי לאוין - דאין ביד האב להשיאה אלא למי שקידושין תופסין בה. והא דר"ע לקמן בפרקין (שם):
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:6:2.english: Betrothal does not take effect with those liable for [violating] negative commandments - For it is not in the father's power to marry her off except to someone with whom betrothal takes effect upon her. And this [teaching] of Rabbi Akiva is [stated] later in our chapter (ibid.).

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:7:1.hebrew: ה"ג הרי בידו להשיאה אלמנה לכ"ג וכר' סימאי - כלומר: אם אלמנה היא, הרי בידו להשיאה לכ"ג, ואפי' לר"ע — דאע"ג דחייבי לאוין היא, מודה ר' עקיבא דקידושין תופסין לו בה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:7:1.english: This is the correct text: "It is in his power to marry her off [as] a widow to a High Priest, and in accordance with Rabbi Simai" - That is to say: If she is a widow, behold, it is in his power to marry her off to a High Priest; and even according to Rabbi Akiva, for even though she is [subject to] a negative commandment, Rabbi Akiva concedes that betrothal takes effect for him with her.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:7:2.hebrew: וכדרבי סימאי - דאמר: מן הכל — שהן חייבי לאוין — עושה ר' עקיבא הוולד ממזר, דקסבר אין קידושין תופסין בחייבי לאוין, חוץ מאלמנה לכ"ג:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:7:2.english: And in accordance with Rabbi Simai - For he said: In all [cases] that are [violations of] negative commandments, Rabbi Akiva deems the offspring a mamzer — as he maintains that betrothal does not take effect with those subject to negative commandments — except for a widow to a High Priest.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:7:3.hebrew: שהרי אמרה תורה אלמנה לא יקח - וסמיך ליה: "ולא יחלל זרעו בעמיו", דמשמע: חללין הוא עושה זרעו — שמחוללין מן הכהונה — ואינו עושה ממזרין. וכיון דאין הולד ממזר, ש"מ ס"ל קידושין תופסין בחייבי לאוין דכהונה, דאי אין קידושין תופסין — הוי הולד ממזר, כדתנן בפרקין (לעיל קידושין סו:): כל שאין לה קידושין עליו — הולד ממזר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:7:3.english: As the Torah stated: “A widow…shall he not take” - And juxtaposed to it [is]: “And he shall not profane his seed among his people” (Leviticus 21:15), which implies: he renders his offspring profaned [ḥalalim] — who are profaned from the priesthood — and he does not render [them] mamzerim. And since the offspring is not a mamzer, conclude from this [that Rabbi Akiva] holds that betrothal takes effect with those subject to negative commandments of the priesthood; for if betrothal did not take effect, the offspring would be a mamzer, as we learned in our chapter (above, Kiddushin 66b): “Anyone who cannot contract betrothal with him, the offspring is a mamzer.”

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:8:1.hebrew: כרבי ישבב - מתני' כרבי ישבב אליבא דרבי עקיבא ס"ל, דאמר: בואו ונצווח על עקיבא בן יוסף שמרבה פסולין בישראל, שהיה אומר: "כל שאין לו ביאה בישראל — הולד ממזר". כל איש בישראל שאין ביאתו מותרת באשה שיבא עליה — הולד שנולד מאותה ביאה ממזר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:8:1.english: In accordance with Rabbi Yeshevav - The Mishnah holds in accordance with Rabbi Yeshevav according to Rabbi Akiva, who said: "Come, let us shout at Akiva ben Yosef, who increases [the number of] disqualified people in Israel, for he would say: 'Anyone who may not engage in intercourse in Israel, the offspring is a mamzer.'" [That is,] any man in Israel whose intercourse is not permitted with a woman with whom he engages in intercourse, the offspring born from that intercourse is a mamzer.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:9:1.hebrew: הניחא אי טעמא דנפשיה קאמר - ולאו לאפוקי מדר' סימאי לחודיה אתי, לאיפלוגי אחייבי לאוין דכהונה לחודייהו, אלא כלל הוא בידו: שכל ביאה שהיא בעבירה — הולד ממזר; ושפיר מתרצינן למתני', דאין קידושי עבירה קידושין, ואין ביד האב להשיא בתו למי שמחללה בביאתו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:9:1.english: This works out well if he states a reasoning of his own - And he did not come merely to exclude [the view] of Rabbi Simai, to disagree solely regarding those subject to negative commandments of the priesthood, but rather he holds a general principle: that [with] any intercourse that is [committed] in transgression, the offspring is a mamzer; and we can well resolve the Mishnah, [explaining] that a betrothal [involving] a transgression is not a [valid] betrothal, and it is not in the father's power to marry his daughter to someone who profanes her through his intercourse.

Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:9:2.hebrew: אלא אי לאפוקי מדר' סימאי אתי - ולא להוסיף אלא אחייבי לאוין דכהונה, אבל במצרי ואדומי תוך ג' דורות, שהן חייבי עשה, מודה דקידושין תופסין לו בה — הרי בידו להשיאה להן, והן מחללין אותה מתרומה ומן הכהונה, כדלקמן (קידושין דף עד:):
Rashi on Kiddushin 64a:9:2.english: Rather, if he comes to exclude [the opinion] of Rabbi Simai - and not to add except regarding those liable for negative commandments of the priesthood, but regarding an Egyptian and an Edomite within three generations, who are [those] liable for positive commandments, he concedes that betrothal takes effect for him with her — behold, it is in his power to marry her to them, and they disqualify her from [eating] terumah and from the priesthood, as [stated] below (Kiddushin 74b):

Tosafot on Kiddushin 64a:1:1.hebrew: נאמן לנדרים - דעד אחד נאמן באיסורין. תימה: הא אין נאמן אלא בדבר שבידו! וי"ל: כיון דסופו ליגדל, עשאוהו כדבר שבידו. מיהו קשה: מאי איריא אב? אפי' אחר נמי! וי"ל: דאב דייק טפי לדעת שניו, לפי שעליו מוטל להודיעו לאחרים; ולכך לאב עשאוהו כבידו, ולא לאחרים:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 64a:1:1.english: [The father is] deemed credible with regard to vows - For a single witness is believed in [matters of ritual] prohibitions. [Yet] this is astonishing: For [a single witness] is believed only in a matter that is in his power [to effect]! And one can say: Since [the child] will ultimately grow up, they treated it as a matter that is in his power. However, it is difficult: Why specifically the father? Even someone else as well [should be believed]! And one can say: Because a father is more meticulous in knowing his [child's] age, since it is incumbent upon him to make it known to others; and therefore, for a father they treated it as [a matter] in his power, but not for others.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 64a:5:1.hebrew: [כר' דוסתאי וכו' - פרש"י: כיון שבתו כשרה אלמנתו כשרה, וכו'. ור"י אומר טעם אחר: דאם היה פוסלה בביאתו לא היו הבנים כשרים, דה"ל כחלל שנשא חללה, דלכ"ע הולד חלל. ת"י]:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 64a:5:1.english: ["In accordance with Rabbi Dostai, etc." - Rashi explained: Since his daughter is fit, his widow is fit, etc. And the Ri says another reason: For if he disqualified her through his act of intercourse, the children would not be fit, as it would be like a ḥalal who married a ḥalalah, where according to everyone the offspring is a ḥalal. Tosafot Yeshanim]:
